meta.title: Knowledge base
meta.description: Builds local knowledge bases for the agent from external knowledge sources. Confluence Server / Data Center is supported now — over its REST API (token or user and password) or from an HTML export zip; Jira, Obsidian and other sources are planned. The agent gets four tools — search, read, review queue, and health — with provenance on every result: the article's last-modified date and status, so facts taken from old pages are flagged instead of trusted.
